item.title: Fabienne Raabe
item.description: Fabienne worked on data processing and behavioural analyses in movement ecology projects within the Move.inFormation group.

item.title: Anna Schneider
item.description: Anna contributed to research on movement ecology and biologging analyses within the group. Her work helped develop analytical approaches for interpreting high-resolution sensor data and understanding behavioural patterns in tracked animals.
